title: Modeling of Rayleigh-type waves in a viscoelastic piezoelectric fiber-reinforced composite layered Structure
title_zh: 粘弹性压电纤维增强复合材料层状结构中瑞利型波的建模
summary: 研究了粘弹性压电纤维增强复合材料（ VRFRC ）层中瑞利型表面波通过机械不完美界面结合到各向同性弹性半空间上的传播。复合材料的两种成分都是耗散的： PZT纤维被处理为粘弹性压电固体，环氧基体被处理为粘弹性电介质，各自由作用于应力应变和电场-电位移对的开尔文-沃伊特元素描述，因此每个相和均匀化复合材料都是被动的。复杂、频率相关的有效常数是通过弹性-粘弹性对应原理将复杂成分常数引入材料强度/混合规则（ SM/RM ）关系中获得的。
abstract: The propagation of Rayleigh-type surface waves in a viscoelastic piezoelectric fiber-reinforced composite (VRFRC) layer bonded to an isotropic elastic half-space through a mechanically imperfect interface is investigated. Both constituents of the composite are dissipative: the PZT fibers are treated as viscoelastic piezoelectric solids and the epoxy matrix as a viscoelastic dielectric, each described by Kelvin–Voigt elements acting on the stress–strain and on the electric field–electric displacement pairs, so that every phase, and the homogenized composite, is passive. The complex , frequency-dependent effective constants are obtained by introducing the complex constituent constants into the strength-of-materials/rule-of-mixtures (SM/RM) relations through the elastic–viscoelastic correspondence principle. The imperfect bond is represented by normal and tangential linear-slip conditions, the upper surface is traction-free and electrically open, and the metallic substrate grounds the interface. An exact 8 × 8 complex dispersion relation is derived and solved, without any small-loss approximation, for the phase velocity and the normalized attenuation of the fundamental mode. The results show that the fiber volume fraction controls the dispersion through the layer stiffness and piezoelectric stiffening, the viscous relaxation times of the matrix (chiefly η c,q 33 and η c,q 44) control the attenuation while leaving the phase velocity almost unchanged, fiber viscoelasticity becomes significant only at high fiber content, and interfacial compliance, in particular the normal compliance, lowers the phase velocity and the attenuation in the dispersive range. Mode shapes, particle orbits, the electric potential distribution and a velocity-based electromechani-cal coupling measure are also analysed; the group velocity shows a pronounced Airy-phase minimum that is sensitive to the fiber content and the bond quality, and the velocity-based coupling measure K 2 = 2(c open − c short)/c open reaches about 3.3% for fiber-rich layers.

title: UTe₂ reveals two flavors of superconductivity under extreme pressure
title_zh: UTe2 揭示了极压下两种超导特性
summary: 量子研究人员正在寻找一种拓扑超导体，这种材料如果被发现，将通过结合两种不同的超导“风味”，从而在量子计算方面取得重大进展。
abstract: Quantum researchers are searching for a topological superconductor—a material that, if discovered, would allow major advances in quantum computing by combining two distinct "flavors" of superconductivity.

title: What a radical-pair quantum reservoir would require: readable capacity, no quantum advantage, and a nuclear-register criterion
title_zh: 自由基对量子库需要什么：可读能力，没有量子优势，以及核寄存器标准
summary: 自由基对磁感受背后的电子-核自旋相干性是否也可以支持生物计算已经被推测了几十年，但从未进行过定量。我们将隐色素型自由基对视为贮存计算机，通过电子退相干解决自由基对主方程，并像真正的周转一样驱动它--通过自旋相关对的诞生，其单重字符对输入进行编码。接下来是三个结果，但没有一个是预期的结果。储层可由普通化学物质进行强化：产品带走的核极化使其无记忆底板2.0的样本外信息处理能力为4.7 ，没有光谱。没有量子优势：经典的网络匹配通道对通道超出五自旋储层49--123%。
abstract: Whether the electron--nuclear spin coherence behind radical-pair magnetoreception could also support biological emphcomputation has been conjectured for decades but never made quantitative. We treat a cryptochrome-type radical pair as a reservoir computer, solving the radical-pair master equation with electronic decoherence and driving it as a real turnover does---by the birth of a spin-correlated pair whose singlet character encodes the input. Three results follow, none of them the expected one. The reservoir is emphreadable by ordinary chemistry: the nuclear polarisation the product carries away gives an out-of-sample information-processing capacity of 4.7 against its own memoryless floor of 2.0, with no spectroscopy. There is no quantum advantage: a classical network matched channel-for-channel exceeds the five-spin reservoir by 49--123%. And the memory horizon is set not by the microsecond pair lifetime but by the turnover interval, because the nuclear register survives recombination in the diamagnetic product---so the binding constraint is chemical rather than temporal, namely that the emphsame register be reused between turnovers. Predicting the register's relaxation instead of assuming it makes that constraint testable: at the geomagnetic field a proton on the intact protein relaxes in milliseconds, not seconds, capping the horizon below the neural band unless the register's dipolar vector reorients about two and a half times faster than the protein (τᵣₘ ₑfflesssim6~ns). What survives is a smaller claim on firmer ground: a criterion whose two constants can be measured in vitro, in place of one whose central relaxation time was never measured at all.
